lex:
ἐμ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָלָה, etc. ;]
to step into: Jhn.5:4 (WH, RV omit); εἰς πλοῖον, to embark: Mat.8:23 9:1 13:2 14:22 15:39, Mrk.4:1 5:18 6:45 8:10, 13, Luk.5:3 8:22, 37, Jhn.6:17, 24 21:3, Act.21:6.†

strongs.def: to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool)
strongs.kjv: come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship
strongs.from: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G939 (βάσις)
